risk_if_not_implemented: Without Restrict Sensitive / Regulated Data Access To Authorized Individuals, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Media Access (DCH-07.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_2.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Media Access (DCH-07.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
